notes: Used as a noun, 'der Husten' refers to the condition of coughing. When you want to describe the act of coughing itself as a verb, use 'husten' (e.g., 'Ich huste' - I am coughing).
It is common to specify the type of cough by adding an adjective, such as 'trockener Husten' (dry cough) or 'verschleimter Husten' (productive cough).
